nom: T.N. Dickinson's Witch Hazel 100% Natural Astringent

segments.oily: The reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports it minimizes oil and unclogs pores, and did not dry her skin out despite its alcohol content.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report it feels gentle rather than harsh, with no breakouts or irritation.

concerns.dehydration: The one reviewer with oily skin who addresses this reports the alcohol content did not dry her skin out, though she cautions that those with dry skin should dilute it first.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, describe it as gentle and non-irritating rather than harsh.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report their skin tone brightened or their acne scars began fading with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report it helps control acne, including cystic pimples and back acne, with less oiliness and fewer breakouts over time; no reviewer in this set reports it made their acne worse.
concerns.oiliness: The reviewers who mention oil control report it reduces how oily their skin gets and helps unclog pores.

extraits.texte: This product is great but they shipped it in a bag and it came cracked and leaking all over the place with half the product gone. So disappointed.

extraits.titre: Great for oily, acne prone skin. Great toner!
extraits.texte: I literally love this stuff! This is my second purchase of my bottle from Pharmapacks. It's always sealed & packaged properly & they usually give you a discount for your next purchase! I use this as a natural facial toner. I cleanse with my cleanser and then wet a cotton ball with the witch hazel & apply it to my face twice a day, every other day. It's great for oily, acne prone skin. It minimizes the amount of oil I get and unclogs my pores! It's also great for cystic pimples. It seems that this has also brightened my skin tone up a bit too. I noticed this bottle does contain 12% alcohol, but my skin can handle it. It never dries my skin out. Most store bought toners contain way more than that anyway! Just be careful with this if you have dry skin. If you do, you can try diluting it. It lasts for a pretty long time ... maybe 3-6 months or so? The smell is pretty bad at first.Indescribable. I remember almost throwing up the first time I opened the bottle! After a couple weeks, you definitely get used to the smell. I've been using it for about a year and I don't notice it anymore. Will definitely purchase again!

I have recently been suffering from acne on my face and back. I was desperate to find something to fix the problem, but nothing seemed to work. Three weeks ago, I found a recipe for a toner on the internet using ¾ cups of witch hazel with 15 drops of tea tree essential oil (I used plant therapy). Magically, the toner worked! I have noticed a world of difference on my skin. My skin is less oily, my acne scars are beginning to fade, and I have less pimples than before. I can’t recommend this enough if you are suffering from acne. This product deserves FIVE stars!
Received just as described. Has the typical witch hazel scent. Just received it so I only used it once, and my sensitive skin didn’t break out. That’s a great sign.
This is the best Witch Hazel I ever used. Its perfect for my sensitive skin.

Great for cleaning the face after showering or right before bed. I use a cotton pad to clean my face before bed, leaving my face feeling refreshed. It is not harsh on your skin. I'm not too fond of the smell, but it is not terrible. Overall I recommend this product if you are looking to clean your face before bed.
YOU better know it!! I love this product and will use it for life. Kills acne, tones the face and tighten.
